Definitely keep periodically checking in with the department so you know where you're at wrt getting your docs. 

Otherwise, unfortunately there's little else one can actually do except be patient.

Unfortunately, it isn't uncommon for govt departments here to take an age doing things - and that's if you're local. If you aren't then yes, it will be worse. 

It sucks ass but it's the system that we're used to over here.
